name: Product manager
description: Plans, writes and communicates product work with agents.

axes.name: Problem framing
axes.measures: Work starts from the user problem and the expected outcome

axes.name: Decision records
axes.measures: Decisions, trade-offs and open questions are written down

axes.name: Stakeholder communication
axes.measures: Updates and documents fit their readers

axes.name: Prioritization
axes.measures: Effort goes to the most important work first
